title: Unisex Chef – Cooks for 200. Cereal at Home. Hoodie

seo.title: Chef Hoodie – Cooks for 200. Cereal at Home.
seo.description: A funny chef hoodie for line cooks: COOKS FOR 200. CEREAL AT HOME. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

COOKS FOR 200. CEREAL AT HOME. is the chef hoodie for line cooks, servers and culinary students who feed a full house all night and go home to a bowl of cereal, worn to the walk-in, the late shift and the midnight snack.

COOKS FOR 200. runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and CEREAL AT HOME. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a tired line cook in a white chef jacket, bandana and red apron sits slumped on an upturned milk crate, eating a big bowl of cereal with half-lidded eyes beside a tall stack of steel sauté pans and a rail full of order slips.

Navy carries cream and soft tomato-red lettering with a cream edge around the cook; Sand gets dark navy and deep red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a long kitchen shift?
Yes. The Cooks for 200. Cereal at Home. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for the walk-in, the walk home after close and the cold ride back to the apartment.

How does the Cooks for 200. Cereal at Home. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a chef or line cook?
It is a natural one. Every line cook has cooked for a full house and gone home to cereal, so it lands with the kitchen crew, servers and partners who eat midnight cereal with them. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the line cook sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Cooks for 200. Cereal at Home. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
